scope: Randomized variants of the 2 and 5 target requests of five Paladin builds (validation/2026-10-06-multi-target-paladin-sweep/*.base.json): the production Retribution and Shockadin requests, whose rotations cast Consecration, the same two against Undead and Demon copies of the boss with Holy Wrath and Consecration lines on numberTargets >= 2, and the Retribution request with a multidot line for Consecration. 12 for each base at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical, and draws each variant's race from Human and Dwarf.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-06-multi-target-paladin-sweep/NAME-N-targets.base.json --seed 20261006 --count 12 --iterations 200 --races RaceHuman,RaceDwarf --output <scratch>/NAME-N for each base, adding --max-distance 5 for the Retribution bases; each variant <scratch>/NAME-N/sweep-XX.json is compared as NAME-N-targets-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants named as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log. Consecration lands on the copies in 92 of the 120 variants and Holy Wrath in 42, as the Go results show.
The Protection builds are not swept: the exporter refuses a tank assignment against several targets, as the reference record shows.
